finding: Informal direct-method statements omit equilibrium/domain/regularity and global boundedness conditions, and negative derivative must exclude the equilibrium.

finding: Informal settling language can conflate Lyapunov stability with asymptotic convergence.

finding: The right-hand prose applies zero velocity to all trajectories and writes −kx despite the nonlinear k(x) example. The ODE xddot=−kx itself has nonzero solutions.
handling: Interpret only trajectories remaining in zero dissipation; persistent zero velocity implies zero acceleration, then nonlinear k(x)=0 forces x=0 under the strict sign condition.
